title: Exact hostname match for isHost
prompt: Fix the module src/host.mjs, which exports isHost(url, host). isHost must return true only when the hostname parsed from url equals host, comparing in lower case. It must return false for every other input. A string that is not a valid absolute URL returns false. A host name that appears only in the path, query or fragment returns false. User info tricks, such as an address with the wanted host before an at sign, return false because the real host is the one after the at sign. Look-alike hosts that merely start or end with the wanted host return false. Non-string arguments and an empty host return false. Keep the export name and signature unchanged.
